plans.idea: Mirror the original's centred composition: one generous text block on the vertical optical centre (slightly above the middle), so the headline stacks into short lines and the subheadline sits right under it as its sign-off, with even dark space above and below and the decorative circle left alone at the bottom.

Top-anchored skyscraper read: a tall text block runs from the top margin down past the midpoint, so the headline gets the largest possible size and the brand line follows directly beneath it, with the lower canvas left as quiet space for the circle decoration.

Full-height column: the text box spans most of the banner's height so the headline breaks into one or two words per line at a large size, like a vertical poster, with a small minor slot tucked into the top margin and the bottom kept clear of the circle.
